text: At 14:02 maya reported alerts for payments-gateway with a 12% 5xx rate.
At 14:04 tomas acked and took incident commander.
Deploy 4471 went out at 13:55 and touched the retry logic.
Maya noted the error budget burned 30% in the last 10 minutes.
Lena checked that the card processor status page shows no incident.
Nikhil saw retries amplifying load on the ledger-db primary.
At 14:13 tomas decided to roll back deploy 4471.
Nikhil started the rollback and expected 5 minutes.
At 14:21 the rollback finished and the 5xx rate was falling.
At 14:26 maya confirmed the 5xx rate was back under 1%.
Lena relayed that support reported about 340 failed checkouts during the window.
Tomas declared recovery and kept watch for 30 minutes.
Nikhil identified the root cause: the retry change removed the backoff, so retries fired immediately.
Action item: add a load test for retry behaviour, owner nikhil.
Action item: alert on ledger-db connection saturation, owner lena.
Lena said customers saw declined cards and a generic error page.
At 14:55 maya updated the status page to resolved.
Tomas closed the incident and planned the postmortem for Friday.
Nikhil filed ticket PAY-212 for the follow-up.
Lena saw dashboards for ledger-db with connections back to normal.
Maya added that the backoff setting is now covered by a config test.
Nikhil said we should document the retry defaults in the runbook.
At 15:12 tomas thanked everyone for the response.
Lena heard that merchant @acme-shop confirmed their orders are going through.
Maya saw queue depth for refunds peak at 2400 messages.
Nikhil reported the refund queue drained by 15:19.
Two engineers stay on call overnight, said Tomas.
Lena noted latency p99 was 1.5 seconds at the peak.
Maya said the Grafana board PaymentsOverview has the full timeline.
Nikhil plans to ship the fix behind a feature flag next week.
Tomas said the review of the alert thresholds is pending.
Lena said one customer escalated through their account manager.
Maya confirmed the pager rotation was correct and nobody was missed.
Nikhil said the CI pipeline now blocks changes to retry config without review.
Tomas said customers with failed payments will get an email.
Lena said finance wants the exact count of affected orders.
Maya said the count will come from the ledger export.
Nikhil scheduled the export job for 16:00.
Tomas wrote a handover note for the evening shift.
At 16:00 lena reported the export done with 338 orders affected.
At 09:10 priya reported stale search results with indexer lag of 45 minutes.
Owen looked at the indexer queue in Kafka.
Owen found that consumer group search-indexer has 3 of 6 partitions without a consumer.
Sasha saw two indexer pods in CrashLoopBackOff.
At 09:20 sasha saw pod logs with OutOfMemoryError while building the shard.
Priya found the memory limit was lowered to 2 GB in last week config change.
At 09:27 owen raised the limit to 4 GB and redeployed.
At 09:33 sasha saw the pods healthy again with lag dropping.
Priya saw lag at 10 minutes and still falling.
At 10:05 owen confirmed lag was zero and the indexer caught up.
Action item: add memory alert for the indexer, owner sasha.
Action item: review resource limits in the config change process, owner priya.
Owen said users saw missing products for about 55 minutes.
Sasha said mobile app search was not affected.
Priya said the config change was reviewed but nobody checked the memory number.
Owen started a draft of the timeline.
Sasha saved a heap dump to the debug bucket.
Priya said the product team asked for an ETA on reindexing the long tail.
Owen said reindex of the long tail takes about 2 hours.
At 10:30 sasha started the reindex job.
Priya reported reindex progress at 20%.
Owen reported reindex progress at 45%.
Sasha reported reindex progress at 80%.
At 11:40 priya said the reindex finished and spot checks look right.
At 11:45 owen closed the incident.
Sasha saw Kafka dashboards with lag of 0 on every partition.
Priya said customer success will reply to the 14 tickets.
Owen scheduled the postmortem for Thursday.
Sasha said the old memory value came from a staging template.
Priya said the staging template will be fixed in the repo.
Owen said ticket SRCH-88 tracks the template fix.
Sasha said the runbook needs a section on partition assignment.
Priya will write the runbook section.
Owen said alert thresholds for lag are 15 minutes warn and 30 minutes page.
Sasha said the lag alert did fire at 09:05 but went to a muted channel.
Priya said the muted channel is being routed to the on-call pager.
Owen said this was the second lag incident this quarter.
Sasha said the first one was a network partition in March.
Priya said it was a different cause with the same symptom.
Owen said done for today and thanked all.
At 07:45 rosa reported users cannot log in and the SSO redirect returns 502.
Ivan saw ingress logs with TLS handshake errors to the identity provider.
Ivan found the certificate for idp.internal expired at 07:30.
Rosa saw the auto renewal job last ran 90 days ago.
Kenji said the renewal job was disabled during the cluster migration.
At 07:58 kenji issued a new certificate manually.
At 08:05 kenji installed the new certificate on the identity provider.
At 08:08 ivan saw handshake errors stop and logins working.
Rosa saw login success rate at 99% again.
Ivan said about 1800 login attempts failed in 38 minutes.
Action item: re-enable renewal job and add expiry alert, owner kenji.
Action item: inventory every certificate that has no renewal, owner rosa.
Ivan said users on VPN were not affected.
Kenji said the renewal job is enabled again and ran successfully.
Rosa said the next expiry is in 60 days.
Ivan set the expiry alert for 14 days before.
Kenji said the migration checklist did not mention certificates.
Rosa updated the checklist with a certificate step.
At 08:45 ivan closed the incident.
Kenji removed the customer facing banner.
The postmortem owner is rosa.
Ivan created tracing ticket AUTH-31.
Kenji looked at who else has manual certificates.
Rosa found 3 more certificates with no renewal.
Two of them expire within 30 days, said ivan.
Kenji is renewing both today.
Rosa said the third one belongs to the payments team.
Ivan pinged the payments team lead.
Kenji said payments confirmed they will renew it.
Rosa said the support macro for login errors can be retired.
Ivan saw the metrics export show no more 502 responses.
Kenji said staging uses a self signed certificate so it was not affected.
Rosa praised the catch from the on-call rotation.
Ivan said pager noise was low during the incident.
Kenji will write the timeline for the review.
Rosa set the review meeting for Wednesday at 10:00.
Ivan asked to add logs from the ingress controller.
Kenji attached logs to the ticket.
Rosa thanked the team, that is everything.
Ivan signed off.
Kenji signed off too.
At 02:10 dmitri saw the nightly billing batch still running after 3 hours.
Amara said normal runtime is 45 minutes.
Amara found the job stuck on table invoice_lines.
Dmitri found a long running transaction holding a lock on invoice_lines.
Dmitri found the transaction belongs to an analytics export started at 23:50.
At 02:24 amara asked analytics to stop the export.
At 02:30 dmitri saw the export stopped and the lock released.
Amara saw the batch job progressing again.
Dmitri reported the batch finished at 03:18 and invoices will be late by about 2 hours.
Action item: run analytics exports against the replica, owner amara.
Action item: add lock timeout to the batch job, owner dmitri.
Amara planned to send invoices at 04:00 instead of 02:00.
Dmitri said finance has been told about the delay.
Amara said no data was lost.
Dmitri said the analytics team agreed to use the replica.
Amara said replica lag is usually under 5 seconds.
Dmitri said the batch alert only fires after 6 hours.
At 04:00 amara sent the invoices.
Dmitri said the alert threshold will be lowered to 90 minutes.
Amara is writing down the timeline now.
Dmitri saved the lock monitor query in the runbook.
Amara opened ticket BILL-402 for the lock timeout.
Dmitri opened ticket BILL-403 for the alert threshold.
Amara is going to bed and is back at 09:00.
Dmitri handed over to the morning on-call.
Amara checked in the morning: invoices delivered with bounce rate 0.4%.
Dmitri said three customers asked about the late invoice.
Amara replied with a standard explanation.
Dmitri said analytics export now uses the replica.
Amara verified in the connection logs.
Dmitri merged the lock timeout change.
Amara merged the alert threshold change.
Dmitri said a test run tonight will confirm.
Amara said a postmortem is not required and a summary is enough.
Dmitri agreed.
At 09:50 amara closed the incident.
Dmitri said thanks.
Amara moved the weekly billing review to 11:00.
Dmitri noted it.
Amara is out of office until Monday.
Dmitri said enjoy.
Deploy 4471 went out at 13:55 and the rollback finished at 14:21.
After the rollback started the 5xx rate fell, and at 14:26 it was under 1%.
Retries amplified load on the ledger-db primary after deploy 4471 touched the retry logic.
Lag of 45 minutes was caused by 3 of 6 partitions having no consumer.
At 09:27 owen raised the limit to 4 GB after the limit was lowered to 2 GB.
The certificate for idp.internal expired at 07:30 and a new certificate was installed at 08:05.
Ivan and kenji restored logins: kenji issued the certificate and ivan saw logins working at 08:08.
The export started at 23:50 held a lock on invoice_lines and was stopped at 02:30.
Amara asked analytics to stop the export and dmitri saw the lock released.
Alerts fired because the payments-gateway error rate reached 12%.
Tomas became incident commander.
The team decided to revert deploy 4471.
Once the rollback completed, 5xx errors started to fall.
Roughly 340 checkouts failed according to support.
The removed backoff made retries fire right away.
Roughly 1,800 logins failed during 38 minutes.
The auto renewal job had not run for 90 days.
By 08:12 the login success rate had recovered to 99%.
The migration of the cluster had switched the renewal job off.
At 02:10 dmitri noticed the billing batch had been running three hours.
A long-running transaction was blocking invoice_lines.
Billing finished at 03:18, which pushed invoices about two hours late.
Invoices went out at 04:00 rather than 02:00.
The memory limit had been reduced to 2 GB the week before.
Indexer pods recovered and lag started falling.
Roughly 55 minutes of missing products affected users.
Sasha will add a memory alert for the indexer.
The indexer caught up and lag reached zero at 10:05.
Half of the six partitions had no consumer.
Owen increased the limit to 4 GB and redeployed the pods.
